title: Grim Reaper and Mouse
description: A surreal night scene shows a white mouse standing on a mossy rock holding a tall stem with a giant bloodshot eyeball containing a smaller white mouse inside. In the upper right, the Grim Reaper in a red hooded robe stands on a cliff edge pointing toward the eye, with a full moon featuring skull and ghost faces behind him. Paper boats float on the water below amid purple flowers and swirling blue lines.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night scene with a white and purple mouse standing on a mossy rock by a lake, holding a long stem topped with a giant bloodshot eyeball that contains a tiny white mouse inside its pupil. In the sky, the Grim Reaper in a dripping red and green hooded cloak stands on a cliff, pointing at the eye while holding a staff with a skull. A large glowing moon with skull and ghost faces illuminates the scene. Paper boats float on the misty blue water, surrounded by glowing purple flowers and swirling ethereal lines.
